import random
M=0xffffffff
def rotl(v,n): return ((v<<n)|(v>>(8-n)))&0xff
def rotr(v,n): return ((v>>n)|(v<<(8-n)))&0xff
def g(a,b,x): return rotl((a+b+x)&0xff,2)
def f(v):
    x=[v&255,(v>>8)&255,(v>>16)&255,(v>>24)&255]
    y2=g(x[3]^x[2],x[1]^x[0],1)
    y3=g(x[3],y2,0)
    y1=g(x[1]^x[0],y2,0)
    y0=g(x[0],y1,1)
    return y0 | (y1<<8) | (y2<<16) | (y3<<24)
def finv(o):
    y0=o&255; y1=(o>>8)&255; y2=(o>>16)&255; y3=(o>>24)&255
    x3=(rotr(y3,2)-y2)&255
    p=(rotr(y1,2)-y2)&255
    x0=(rotr(y0,1)-y1)&255
    x1=x0^p
    s=(rotr(y2,2)-1)&255
    x2=x3^s
    return x0|(x1<<8)|(x2<<16)|(x3<<24)
for v in [0,1,0x12345678,0xffffffff]+[random.getrandbits(32) for _ in range(1000)]:

import random
M = 0xffffffff

def rotl2(v):
    v &= 0xff
    return ((v << 2) | (v >> 6)) & 0xff

def rotr2(v):
    v &= 0xff
    return ((v >> 2) | (v << 6)) & 0xff

def g(a, b, x):
    return rotl2((a + b + x) & 0xff)

def f(v):
    v &= M
    x = [v & 255, (v >> 8) & 255, (v >> 16) & 255, (v >> 24) & 255]
    y2 = g(x[3] ^ x[2], x[1] ^ x[0], 1)
    y3 = g(x[3], y2, 0)
    y1 = g(x[1] ^ x[0], y2, 0)
    y0 = g(x[0], y1, 1)
    return (y0 | (y1 << 8) | (y2 << 16) | (y3 << 24)) & M

def finv(o):
    y0 = o & 255; y1 = (o >> 8) & 255; y2 = (o >> 16) & 255; y3 = (o >> 24) & 255
    p = (rotr2(y1) - y2) & 255
    x3 = (rotr2(y3) - y2) & 255
    x0 = (rotr2(y0) - y1 - 1) & 255
    x1 = x0 ^ p
    s = (rotr2(y2) - p - 1) & 255
    x2 = x3 ^ s
    return x0 | (x1 << 8) | (x2 << 16) | (x3 << 24)

def expand(k):
    return (k ^ (k << 16) ^ (k * 12345)) & M

def encrypt(pt, keys):
    L = (pt >> 32) & M
    R = pt & M
    R ^= L
    for k in keys:
        L, R = R, L ^ f(R ^ k)
    L ^= R
    return ((R << 32) | L) & ((1 << 64) - 1)

for v in [0, 1, 0x12345678, M] + [random.getrandbits(32) for _ in range(10000)]:
    assert finv(f(v)) == v, hex(v)
print('FINV_OK')

seeds = [int(x, 16) for x in open('/tmp/test_keys.txt').read().split()]
keys = [expand(k) for k in seeds]
pairs = []
for line in open('/tmp/test_pairs.txt'):
    p, c = map(int, line.split())
    pairs.append((p, c))
    assert encrypt(p, keys) == c, (hex(p), hex(c), hex(encrypt(p, keys)))
print('PAIRS_ENCRYPT_OK', len(pairs))

A0 = [(p >> 32) & M for p, c in pairs]
B0 = [(p & M) ^ A0[i] for i, (p, c) in enumerate(pairs)]
B3 = [(c & M) ^ ((c >> 32) & M) for p, c in pairs]
B4 = [(c >> 32) & M for p, c in pairs]
K0, K1, K2, K3 = keys
for i in range(min(4, len(pairs))):
    B1 = A0[i] ^ f(B0[i] ^ K0)
    B2 = B4[i] ^ f(B3[i] ^ K3)
    k1_est = B1 ^ finv(B0[i] ^ B2)
    k2_est = B2 ^ finv(B1 ^ B3[i])
    print(i, 'k1', hex(k1_est), k1_est == K1, 'k2', hex(k2_est), k2_est == K2)

import sys
M=(1<<32)-1
seeds=[int(x,16) for x in sys.argv[1:5]]
def exp(k): return (k^(k<<16)^(k*12345))&M
keys=[exp(k) for k in seeds]
def rotl2(v): return ((v<<2)|(v>>6))&0xff
def f(v):

    y3=rotl2((x[3]+y2)&0xff)

    y0=rotl2((x[0]+y1+1)&0xff)
